title: Grade 3 Math — Wed, Jun 18
description: Decimals — Day 3 of 5: Comparing and ordering decimals
subject: mathematics

questions.question: To compare decimals, first compare the ___ part.
questions.explanation: When comparing decimals, first compare the whole number (ones) part. Only if they are equal, compare the tenths, then hundredths.

questions.question: Which is greater: 4.5 or 4.8?
questions.explanation: Whole number parts are equal (4 = 4). Compare tenths: 8 > 5. So 4.8 > 4.5.

questions.question: Which is greater: 0.45 or 0.54?
questions.explanation: Both have 0 in ones. Compare tenths: 5 > 4. So 0.54 > 0.45.

questions.question: Which is smaller: 1.07 or 1.70?
questions.explanation: Both have 1 in ones. Compare tenths: 0 < 7. So 1.07 < 1.70.

questions.question: Arrange in ascending order (smallest to largest): 0.5, 0.3, 0.8, 0.1
Arrange in descending order (largest to smallest): 2.3, 2.7, 2.1, 2.5
Use < or >: 0.6 ___ 0.60
questions.explanation: 0.6 = 0.60 (trailing zero doesn't change value). They are equal.

questions.question: Which is the largest? 1.09, 1.9, 0.99, 1.90
questions.explanation: 1.9 = 1.90 (trailing zero). Both equal 1.9, which is larger than 1.09 (same ones, but tenths 9>0) and 0.99.

questions.question: Which decimal comes between 0.5 and 0.7?
questions.explanation: 0.6 is between 0.5 and 0.7. On a number line: 0.5 → 0.6 → 0.7.

questions.question: Priya's height is 1.35 m. Riya's height is 1.53 m. Who is taller?
questions.explanation: Both have 1 in ones. Compare tenths: 5 > 3. So 1.53 > 1.35. Riya is taller.

questions.question: A shopkeeper has weights: 0.50 kg, 0.05 kg, and 0.5 kg. How many are equal?
Tick the correct sign: 3.04 ___ 3.40
questions.explanation: Both have 3 in ones. Compare tenths: 0 < 4. So 3.04 < 3.40.

questions.question: A 100 m race: Kiran finishes in 12.5 s; Mohan in 12.48 s. Who is faster?
questions.explanation: 12.48 < 12.5 (tenths: 4<5). Lower time means faster. Mohan is faster.
